import pandas as pd

# September 2025
start, end = pd.to_datetime("2025-09-01"), pd.to_datetime("2025-09-30 23:59:59")
mask = (order_date >= start) & (order_date <= end)
ov = o[mask]

revenue = items[items["Ma don"].isin(ov["Mã chứng từ"])]["T.Tiền"].sum()
count = len(ov)
avg = revenue / count
print("date_coverage_ok:", order_date.min().date(), order_date.max().date())
print("Count valid orders Sep2025:", count)
print("Revenue:", revenue)
print("Avg revenue/order:", avg)
print("rounded VND:", int(round(avg)))
# sanity: status counts in month
print(ov["Xử lý"].value_counts().to_dict())
